title: Dean M. Collins Shipped A Brilliant Single Track, "Land Where The Wishes Come True"
htmlContent:
Artist Dean M. Collins brings together a powerful trio of bluegrass musicians - Michael Cleveland, Justin Moses, and himself - in the uplifting new track "Land Where The Wishes Come True." With Collins' smooth vocals and the masterful fiddling and mandolin playing of Cleveland and Moses, the song is a toe-tapping celebration of hope and possibility.

Hailing from Nashville, Tennessee, Collins draws on his deep love of Americana and country music to create a unique sound that blends traditional elements with a contemporary sensibility. "Land Where The Wishes Come True" is a perfect example of this, with its catchy chorus and heartfelt lyrics.

As we navigate through challenging times, Collins' music reminds us of the power of perseverance and the importance of holding onto our dreams. With his soulful voice and impeccable musicianship, he invites us to join him on a journey to a place where anything is possible - a land where wishes come true.
